DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: equipment jam
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A set of production equipment has ground to a halt with a shriek of metal. Bearings run hot and gears have seized - years of making do have finally come due.

li.label: Replace the parts
li.description: Spend three components to replace the damaged parts and get the equipment running again at once.

li.label: Make a temporary repair
li.description: Have a skilled builder patch the equipment up for now. It keeps working, but output drops for five days.

li.label: Shut down for maintenance
li.description: Shut the machine off and overhaul it thoroughly. One random production facility is disabled for three days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: enriched materials
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Workers have found that the latest batch of raw materials sent into the workshop is unusually pure.

li.label: Increase output
li.description: Feed the good stock straight into the production line. One random production facility's next output is doubled.

li.label: Reserve it for fine processing
li.description: Seal this batch of materials away on its own, keeping it for finer and more valuable processing.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: obtain a batch of valuable products and sell them
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: That batch of fine materials has finally been worked into finished goods. Neatly made and of superior quality, they will draw plenty of silver out of any trader.

li.label: Process and sell
li.description: Finish the last step of the work and sell the whole batch.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: work accident
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The busy worksite has finally had an accident. The machines have stopped, a crowd has gathered around, and tools and debris still lie scattered on the ground.

li.label: Conduct a full shutdown inspection
li.description: Shut everything down for a full inspection and root out every hidden hazard first. Production drops to half for three days.

li.label: Make modest safety improvements
li.description: Improve safety procedures while production continues. Production x0.7 for three days, then x1.25 for eight days.

li.label: Overhaul safety procedures
li.description: Use this accident to rebuild the whole safety system. Costs 100 steel; production x0.5 for three days, then x1.5 for ten days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: tool shortage
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Hammer heads work loose, blades are rolled and measuring tools read wrong. A great many tools have outlived the day they should have been scrapped, and now they have all quit at once.

li.label: Replace the tools
li.description: Spend 50 steel to fill the most urgent gaps, putting decent tools back in the workers' hands.

li.label: Repair them locally
li.description: Have everyone repair the old tools on the spot.

li.label: Make do
li.description: Keep using them as long as they can still be swung. Production x0.7 for five days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: scrap buildup
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Metal shavings, discarded parts and broken casings are piling higher and higher, already eating into the workspace. Left alone, the workshop will be buried by its own output.

li.label: Recycle it
li.description: Have a crafter with at least 6 Crafting pick the pieces out of the scrap that can still be melted back down.

li.label: Dump it in the wasteland
li.description: Haul the scrap out to the wasteland and dump it. Industrial tendency -3, frontier tendency +3, for eight days.

li.label: Store it temporarily
li.description: Pile it up for now and deal with it later. The workspace is squeezed further; production x0.9 for five days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: process improvement
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A worker who has spent years beside the production line has proposed a new procedure. It looks ugly on paper, but every step comes from firsthand experience.

li.label: Trial the proposal
li.description: Trial it at one random production facility first. Output x1.2 for ten days.

li.label: Reward the proposer
li.description: Pay 300 silver as a reward and polish the proposal, raising the output bonus to x1.4.

li.label: Keep the old process
li.description: The current process at least will not suddenly blow up. Leave it as it is and change nothing.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: prototype test
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Workers have cobbled together a new piece of equipment from spare parts that has never actually been tested. It is already hooked up to power, waiting only for the order to start.

li.label: Put it into production
li.description: Send it straight into production. A random facility's output x1.5 for six days.

li.label: Dismantle it for research
li.description: Take it apart for study before it has an accident.

li.label: Break it down for parts
li.description: Do not gamble on whether it works - break it down into usable parts.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: herd tracks
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Scouts have found fresh hoofprints and snapped brush nearby. A large herd of wild animals passed through here recently, and it has not gone far.

li.label: Organize a hunt
li.description: Send hunters after the herd, drop and butcher the animals on the spot, then haul back every scrap of meat and hide they can carry.

li.label: Keep your distance
li.description: Let them pass. Every meal the wilderness offers can come with tusks and hooves attached.

li.label: Guide the herd away from the roads
li.description: Divert workers to slowly drive the herd off the usual routes, so the next supply column does not run head-on into it.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: road washed out by heavy rain
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Days of heavy rain have cut the dirt road to the outpost into a muddy trench. Wheels sink into it and pack animals can barely get through.

li.label: Repair it immediately
li.description: Pull most of the available workforce onto emergency repairs and reopen this lifeline as fast as possible.

li.label: Wait for the road to recover naturally
li.description: Spend nothing on repairs for now. The road will dry out eventually, but until then every journey is slower and harder.

li.label: Build drainage ditches while rebuilding
li.description: Dig drainage ditches alongside the rebuild. A little more work now buys one less washout later.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: abandoned camp
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A scout has found a camp abandoned in haste at the edge of the wasteland. The fire pit went cold long ago, but the scattered baggage makes it look as though the owners might return at any moment.

li.label: Search for supplies
li.description: Rummage through the tents, crates and ashes, and carry anything still useful back to the outpost.

li.label: Investigate carefully
li.description: Let an experienced thinker reconstruct the scene first, then search methodically. Ruins tend to tell patient people more.

li.label: Do not approach
li.description: This place was abandoned far too suddenly. Keep your distance and touch nothing.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: lost traveler
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A traveler has stumbled into the outpost. Cold, hungry and nearly out of supplies, he asks only for a route he can survive.

li.label: Provide supplies and directions
li.description: Set aside part of the outpost's output to provision him, then point him toward a reasonably safe route.

li.label: Invite him to stay
li.description: People are short here, and so are working hands. Give him a bed and make him one of the outpost's own.

li.label: Refuse him
li.description: Our stores cannot feed everyone who knocks. Send him on his way.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: contaminated water source
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The water source near the outpost has begun to give off an unusual smell. Nobody wants to admit it, but the water in the storage barrels tastes different too.

li.label: Boil the stored water
li.description: Boil all the stored water and put it on ration. You will get through it, but core facilities run at reduced efficiency for two days.

li.label: Find a new water source
li.description: Send people to survey the surroundings until they find clean water that is still safe to drink.

li.label: Continue using it
li.description: Keep drawing on the contaminated source. The work cannot stop, but core facilities lose efficiency because of it.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: hidden cave
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A hillside nearby has suddenly collapsed, exposing a cave mouth that was never recorded. Mineral glints still catch the light along the fresh break.

li.label: Mine the exposed vein
li.description: Send experienced miners in to survey the cave and work the exposed vein.

li.label: Seal the entrance
li.description: Unknown caves are never short of surprises, or of bodies. Seal the entrance - do not gamble the outpost's people on it.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: extreme cold snap or heat wave
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Weather readings show an extreme cold snap or heat wave closing in, strong enough to crush flimsy shelters. The outpost's current protection is nowhere near enough.

li.label: Reinforce the shelters urgently
li.description: Spend 100 steel and 50 wood to reinforce the shelters before the weather arrives. Production dips briefly while the work is done.

li.label: Suspend operations
li.description: Stop most of the work and pull everyone into whatever can keep out the wind and rain. Three days of suspended operations in exchange for everyone's safety.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: wilderness distress signal
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A broken distress call has pushed its way onto the radio. The coordinates are incomplete and wind noise fills the background, but it is unmistakably a human voice.

li.label: Rescue them immediately
li.description: Send a rescue team with enough protection. Bring the survivor back, and carry out whatever supplies can still be salvaged.

li.label: Ask them to come on their own
li.description: Radio them the outpost's position and let them make their own way here. In three to five days we will know whether they managed it.

li.label: Assume it is a trap
li.description: A cry for help in the wasteland can just as easily be bait. Kill the channel and act as though you heard nothing.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: signal lost
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The distress signal grew weaker and weaker until only static was left. Nothing answered after that - whoever sent it never reached the outpost.

li.label: Acknowledge
li.description: Close the channel. The wasteland does not leave a second chance for those who arrive late.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: misdirected cargo
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A shipment that was never meant for here has been delivered to the outpost warehouse. The name on the manifest belongs to someone else, and the crates are already stacked neatly right in front of us.

li.label: Return it voluntarily
li.description: Contact the owner and return the cargo of your own accord, gaining faction goodwill.

li.label: Keep it for ourselves
li.description: Tear off the labels and keep the goods. Gain a shipment of cargo, but lose faction goodwill.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: temporary market
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Several small traveling groups have camped near the outpost. What they carry is a mixed bag, and they propose to trade right here for a few days.

li.label: Open the market
li.description: Open the warehouse to trade. Offer up to 5,000 market value of stock and receive random goods worth 1.5 times as much.

li.label: Charge stall fees
li.description: Let them set up their stalls, but collect the money first.

li.label: Refuse them
li.description: More people means more trouble. Do not open the market.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: bulk order
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A merchant from a nearby settlement has sent a large order. He does not want a few crates of goods - he wants a batch big enough to keep the warehouse and the workshops busy for days on end.

li.label: Accept the order
li.description: Take the order and generate a standard trade request quest.

li.label: Demand extra payment
li.description: Have a skilled negotiator price the risk in first. Collect 500 silver up front, then accept the order.

li.label: Refuse
li.description: Our production line is busy enough already. Decline the order.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: new resident application
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A traveler says he does not want to keep moving on. He is willing to stay and work long-term, asking only for a bed and a place at the outpost.

li.label: Accept
li.description: Take him in. Gain one excellent colonist, but settling him in reduces production for three days.

li.label: Refuse
li.description: This is not a shelter. Reject the application and send him on his way.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: security problem
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The warehouse locks have been forced and the shelves show signs of being rifled through. A count confirms it: about 20% of ordinary stored goods are gone.

li.label: Organize patrols
li.description: Organize armed patrols and lean on the outpost's defenses to recover the stolen goods.

li.label: Investigate publicly
li.description: Have a socially skilled colonist investigate openly, finding the thieves among the crowd and the testimony, and recovering the goods.

li.label: Accept the loss
li.description: Chasing it further only burns more work hours. Accept the loss and drop the matter.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: group migration
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A small group of homeless people has arrived outside the outpost. They do not want to keep wandering; they want to stay together, all of them - along with their hunger, their exhaustion and their willing hands.

li.label: Accept everyone
li.description: Take them all in. Gain three common colonists, but housing and settling them in reduces production for five days.

li.label: Accept only the skilled ones
li.description: Keep only the most useful of them. Gain one excellent colonist; production falls slightly for three days.

li.label: Provision them and send them on
li.description: Give them enough supplies for the road, then send them away. Lose a little output for one day and gain faction goodwill.

li.label: Refuse
li.description: The outpost has no spare beds and no spare rations. Turn the group away.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: unexpected observation
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: In a pile of supposedly dull routine records, researchers have found an anomalous pattern that keeps recurring. Nobody had ever noticed it, but it has clearly been there all along.

li.label: Analyze it deeply
li.description: Pause part of the routine work and dig deep along this lead.

li.label: Apply it immediately
li.description: Do not wait for the paper to be finished - put the pattern to work in production first. A random production facility's output rises for eight days.

li.label: Archive it
li.description: Sort and file the material away, to be dealt with later.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: instrument calibration
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Several batches of measurements in a row show the same deviation. The error has grown too large to fob off with "close enough" any longer.

li.label: Calibrate precisely
li.description: Have a senior researcher calibrate it item by item. Research output rises for ten days.

li.label: Replace components
li.description: Nobody at the outpost is able to handle it, so the key components are simply replaced.

li.label: Correct the data temporarily
li.description: Make do with a correction table for the old data for now. Research output falls for five days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: field sample
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Field workers have brought back samples from nearby that are worth studying. They sit in makeshift containers, still carrying mud and frost from the wilderness.

li.label: Analyze thoroughly
li.description: Hand them to an expert for a thorough analysis.

li.label: Preserve the sample
li.description: Store the samples properly and draw no conclusions yet. Wait for a random follow-up result.

li.label: Treat it as ordinary material
li.description: Research resources are scarcer than samples. Treat it as ordinary material.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: high-value sample
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Further study overturns the initial cautious assessment: this sample is exceptionally valuable, enough to make any research station or caravan name a serious price.

li.label: Exploit it fully
li.description: Squeeze every last drop of value from the discovery and gain a random usable techprint.

li.label: Sell the sample
li.description: Knowledge can be traded for fuel and steel too. Sell the sample and gain a great deal of silver.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: ordinary sample
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: After repeated testing, the preserved sample shows no unusual properties at all. It is simply... ordinary.

li.label: Record the result
li.description: Write the negative result into the record too; "nothing found" is still a finding.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: sample preservation failure
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Nobody noticed in time when the storage container failed. By the time a researcher opened it, the sample had completely spoiled.

li.label: Nothing else to be done
li.description: Record the incident, then throw out what remains. Nothing can be salvaged.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: laboratory accident
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A handling error set off a deflagration, and a hazardous leak was detected soon after. The alarm will not stop, and nobody in the lab area wants to be the first to take off their mask.

li.label: Respond immediately
li.description: Rely on medical experience to deal with the injured and the contamination at once. Research output falls for two days.

li.label: Seal the laboratory
li.description: Seal the lab area off and wait for the danger to fade on its own. One random research facility is disabled for four days.

li.label: Recover the experimental data
li.description: Send medical and intellectual experts to risk recovering the experimental data.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: theoretical breakthrough
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The researchers have proposed a new theory capable of changing the current project's pace. The blackboard is already full, the argument ran on until dark, and now only verification is left.

li.label: Concentrate on verification
li.description: Concentrate people and computing power on the verification work. Research output rises for six days, and other production falls for six days.

li.label: Verify steadily
li.description: Verify steadily without disrupting the outpost's rhythm. Research output rises for ten days.

li.label: Keep the original plan
li.description: Write the theory down for now and carry on with the original plan.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: sealed engineering archive
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: While clearing out old equipment, workers found a sealed set of engineering records. The plans inside describe an unfamiliar production device, but time has eaten away part of the key parameters.

li.label: Try to reconstruct the design
li.description: Assign skilled people to fill in the missing plans. The reconstruction work slows production for two days.

li.label: Dismantle the archived samples
li.description: Give up on a full reconstruction and take apart the samples kept with the archive instead. Gain components and usable research notes.

li.label: Seal it again
li.description: Seal it back up. Not every old set of plans is worth testing with today's lives and work hours.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: efficient transmission system
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The restored plans reveal a surprisingly elegant transmission system. It needs no miracle - only steel, work hours, and one decision: where to install it.

li.label: Install it fully
li.description: Build it to the complete design, raising one random production facility's output by 40% for eight days.

li.label: Run a conservative test
li.description: Run a conservative test and let the workers get familiar with the new design. One random production facility's output rises by 20% for ten days, and the workers get training out of it.

li.label: Compile it into research notes
li.description: There is no need to rush the plans into a machine.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: dangerous design flaw
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Test runs prove that the device really can squeeze out higher output - at the cost of its critical components overheating fast. How long the machine can take it, nobody can say.

li.label: Install heat-resistant parts
li.description: Spend 80 steel and two components on heat-resistant parts, raising one random production facility's output for eight days.

li.label: Run it at reduced power
li.description: Throttle it back and let the machine run right at the safe edge. One random production facility's output rises by 15% for ten days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: cache coordinates in the archive
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: A set of industrial cache coordinates was hidden in the lining of an old archive. The record has yellowed, but the location is still clear - someone buried good things there, waiting for a tomorrow that may never come.

li.label: Organize a recovery team
li.description: Send a recovery team to secure the cache and haul the usable industrial supplies back to the outpost.

li.label: Dismantle the dangerous structure carefully
li.description: Assign skilled builders for two days to take apart the dangerous structure. Slower, but more industrial material comes out of the ruins.

li.label: It is not worth the risk
li.description: A warehouse left by the old era can leave old-era ways to die with it. Abandon the cache.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: unrecoverable draft
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Too much of it is missing. Nobody can say whether this so-called new device was ever built, or whether it existed only in some engineer's over-optimistic draft.

li.label: Document the failure
li.description: Write the failure itself down, so at least whoever comes next does not have to walk the same detour.

li.label: Stop here
li.description: Stop here. Put the remaining papers away and end the reconstruction.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: letter from afar
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: One of the outpost's residents has received a letter that took a long, roundabout road to arrive. Its corners are worn through: his relatives and several companions are searching nearby for a place they can live in for the long term.

li.label: Invite them to come
li.description: Write back and invite them, then wait one to three days for the result.

li.label: Send an escort to meet them
li.description: Divert people for one day to escort them along the way. One day less of work in exchange for them not getting lost in the wilderness.

li.label: Decline politely
li.description: Write as gracious a reply as you can, telling them there is not enough room here either.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: safe arrival
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The people mentioned in the letter have finally appeared outside the outpost. They are shivering with cold and worn out, but they have brought everything they own - this time they truly mean to stay.

li.label: Accept everyone
li.description: Take them all in. Gain two common colonists; housing them reduces production slightly.

li.label: Select the skilled ones
li.description: Keep only the most skilled among them. Gain one excellent colonist; production falls slightly.

li.label: Offer a short rest
li.description: Give them a roof, hot food and a short rest, without promising a permanent place. Population tendency rises for fifteen days.

li.label: Ask them to continue onward
li.description: Supply directions and the most basic advice, then ask them to continue on their way.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: the crafts they bring
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: Several of the visitors live by their hands. Carpenters, metalworkers, repairers - they are willing to trade their work hours for a little help from the outpost.

li.label: Keep the finest craftsperson
li.description: Let them compete to see who is best; we will take only the finest.

li.label: Ask them to train the residents
li.description: Ask them to teach their crafts to the outpost's residents.

li.label: Commission a batch of products
li.description: Commission them to finish a batch of products, doubling a random production facility's next output.

li.label: Provision them and see them off
li.description: Give them full supplies and a decent farewell. Production falls slightly for one day, and population tendency rises for fifteen days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: dispute among the travelers
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The new arrivals quickly split into two camps: some want to stay, others insist on moving on. The argument grows hotter and hotter, until everyone turns to look at the outpost's manager.

li.label: Mediate publicly
li.description: Have a socially skilled colonist mediate openly. Gain one common colonist and improve population tendency.

li.label: House them separately
li.description: House the two sides apart and let whoever wants to stay, stay. Gain two common colonists; production falls for four days.

li.label: Do not intervene
li.description: Their quarrel is not our responsibility. Stay out of it; population tendency falls for ten days.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: lost on the road
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The appointed day has passed, and the travelers never appeared. The last message came through in fragments and confirms only one thing: they lost their way in the wilderness.

li.label: Send a search party
li.description: Send a search party and use the outpost's defenses to bring one traveler back, recovering whatever supplies are found along the way.

li.label: Keep broadcasting directions
li.description: Keep sending out the guiding signal. Production falls slightly for one day, then you will learn whether anyone followed it to the outpost.

li.label: End the search
li.description: The wilderness is too large and our people too few. End the search.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: survivor guided by the signal
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The night watch has finally spotted a stumbling figure outside the outpost. One of the missing travelers followed the radio signal and walked here alone.

li.label: Welcome them in
li.description: Give them hot food and a bed. Gain one common colonist.

DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.label: no answer to the signal
DreamsOutposts.OutpostEventDef.description: The guiding signal went out again and again, but the echo on the radio never turned into a knock at the door. The missing travelers never appeared.

li.label: Acknowledge
li.description: Stop the broadcast. Power, people and hope cannot all be spent without limit.
